title: Notifications, round 2: the outline around the reply, and the jump button at the top

steps.path: A reply where the assistant flagged something for you
steps.headline: Which look should a reply with a new notification have?
steps.notice: In all three the blue goes around the whole reply, and the notification sits at its end under a thin line. The blue goes away when you send a message, click the reply, or rest your pointer on it for a moment; the label and message stay, plain.
steps.risk: Resting the pointer on the reply for about half a second counts as seeing it, so a mouse that stops there by chance clears it too.

variants.label: Outline
variants.summary: A blue outline with a soft glow around the reply. The reply itself keeps its usual colour.

variants.label: Outline and tint
variants.summary: The same outline, and the reply's background turns faintly blue too. Stands out most.
variants.risk: On themes with a coloured bubble, the blue tint mixes with it.

variants.label: Outline and tab
variants.summary: The same outline, with the label as a small tab on the reply's top edge, so you see what it is before reading.
variants.risk: The tab needs a little extra space above the reply.

steps.path: A conversation where the assistant notified you, then kept writing
steps.headline: "Jump to notification" now sits at the top of the chat, just under the bar of conversations.
steps.changed: It moved from above the message box to the top of the chat, centred over the chat (it moves with it when a side panel is open).
steps.notice: It no longer shares the bottom with "Jump to bottom"; each has its own end of the screen.
